# Algorand-IPFS demo

> A block-explorer view of the files registered on the Algorand TestNet by Algorand-IPFS, an open-source tool for secure file sharing with Algorand and IPFS. Each row shows a filename, its IPFS content identifier (CID) and the Algorand transaction that anchors it.

- Algorand-IPFS is a Node.js command-line tool: it encrypts a file on the client with AES-256-CBC, uploads the ciphertext to IPFS, and writes the CID and filename into the note of a 0-Algo self-payment on Algorand. No smart contract is involved.
- This page reads those notes for one demo TestNet address through the AlgoNode public Indexer (no API key) and lists every file found.
- Each CID links to the ipfs.io gateway and each transaction links to the Lora explorer.
- In the demo only `algorand_white_paper.pdf` is encrypted; decrypting it requires the CLI and the matching password.
- First built in 2020 and modernized in 2026 (AlgoNode, algosdk v2, Kubo HTTP RPC, Vue 2.7). MIT license.

## Links

- [Live demo](https://algo-ipfs.surge.sh/): the list of files indexed on-chain
- [Source code](https://github.com/redcpp/algorand-ipfs-js): the CLI, the demo and the README with architecture and security notes
